description:
Fetch transactions with the same amount within ±days of a date.

Used by the classifier to detect duplicates from overlapping CSV imports.

amount.description: The exact signed transaction amount in dollars to match (negative for money out, positive for money in).

date.description: Center date of the window, as YYYY-MM-DD.

days.description: Half-width of the window in days on each side of date (default 14).

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

exclude_id.description: A transaction id to leave out of the results, usually the one being checked; empty to exclude nothing.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

session_id.description: TaxSort session id (the UUID string create_session returns; list_sessions lists yours).

name: taxsort_get_amount_neighbors
title: Find same-amount neighbors
